Bargain Keeper

You agreed to something in a place where the terms were hard to read.

What part of the bargain are you determined to interpret generously?

Rules

Choose one:

- Flame 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.13677c0dc1cd1380.JournalEntryPage.cd21969a936db170]{A Coal for a Promise}. - Mind 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.d7d4ff1e43859673.JournalEntryPage.5258b9fc621e5856]{An Invitation Elsewhere}.

Each option is a pair. Duplicate grants give 1 level-0 DP each; no automatic higher rank. Follow the card’s equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +7 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
